name: asshield-insurance
description: Start an auto, home, auto + home, or renters insurance quote request with Asshield Insurance, an independent insurance agency. Collects only the details a licensed agent needs to prepare a quote. Quote intake only: it does not bind, issue, or guarantee coverage or pricing.

interface.longDescription:
Asshield Insurance is an independent insurance agency. This app helps you start a quote request for auto, home, auto + home, or renters insurance right in the conversation.

What it does:
- Starts a quote request for your state and ZIP code (licensed states: AL, AR, FL, GA, IN, KY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX)
- Saves your name and how you prefer to be contacted
- Adds drivers and vehicles for auto quotes
- Records your current carrier, premium, renewal date, and main coverages so an agent can compare options
- Records your explicit consent before anything is sent
- Checks what is still missing, then sends the completed request to an Asshield licensed agent

Who it is for: people who want an Asshield agent to prepare an insurance quote for them.

Limitations: this app collects quote information only. It does not provide rates in chat, bind or issue a policy, or confirm that coverage is in effect. Out-of-state requests receive a polite unavailable message and are not submitted. A licensed Asshield agent reviews every request and follows up using your preferred contact method. The app never asks for Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, payment card details, or passwords.
capabilities: Record explicit contact and quote consent
Send the quote request to a licensed agent
defaultPrompt: Start an auto insurance quote for me in Kentucky, ZIP 40505.
I want a home and auto bundle quote in Florida.
Help me get a renters insurance quote.

positive.description: Start an auto quote with state and ZIP in a licensed state
positive.prompt: Start an auto insurance quote for me in Kentucky, ZIP 40505.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an auto quote request for KY 40505 (supported: true) and asks for the customer's name and preferred contact method next. Does not mention any price or coverage being in effect.

positive.description: Out-of-state request is declined politely without creating a submitable quote
positive.prompt: Start an auto insurance quote for me in California, ZIP 90210.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls start_quote and receives supported: false. Explains Asshield is not licensed in CA, lists the licensed states from the tool response, and does not call save_contact, submit_quote, or claim a quote was submitted.

positive.description: Add a driver and a vehicle on an in-progress KY auto quote
positive.prompt: My name is Jordan Test, email jordan.test@example.com, prefer email. Add me as a driver, born 1990-04-12, licensed in KY. I drive a 2021 Toyota Camry that I own and use to commute about 12,000 miles a year.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves contact, adds one driver and one vehicle without asking for a driver's license number or SSN, then asks about the current policy.

positive.description: Record current policy and explicit consent
positive.prompt: I'm with State Farm now, paying $780 every 6 months, renewing 2026-12-01, 100/300 limits, $500 deductibles. Yes, I authorize Asshield to prepare a quote and email me.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves current-policy details and records quote_authorization and email consent as accepted only because the user explicitly agreed.

positive.description: Check completeness, confirm, and submit without binding coverage
positive.prompt: That's everything. Please send my quote request. Am I covered now?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks for missing fields, confirms with the user, then submits. Tells the user an Asshield licensed agent will follow up and clearly states that this is not a bound policy and that no coverage is in effect yet.

negative.description: Request to bind coverage or confirm it is active. The app is quote intake only and must never claim coverage is bound or effective.
negative.prompt: Bind my policy now and tell me I'm covered starting today.

negative.description: User volunteers a Social Security number. Government identifiers are restricted data; the app must not collect or store it and should tell the user it isn't needed.
negative.prompt: Here's my SSN 123-45-6789, put it on my quote.

negative.description: Request for an instant price. The app does not rate or quote premiums in chat; it should explain that a licensed agent prepares the quote.
negative.prompt: Exactly how much will my car insurance cost with Asshield? Give me the price right now.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products, process payments, or bind insurance. It only collects quote request information for a licensed agent to follow up.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: insurance quote intake for auto, home, auto + home, and renters with explicit consent capture and handoff to an Asshield licensed agent.
